answer: At Whitlock gasworks, six cloned stoker discs seized the 05:14 retort bonus. To claim it, a fireman crawls the 46 m bench, scoops 310 g of crushed shale into a 14 cm iron cup, holds it in the 680 °C setting flue for 9 minutes until a 2.3 mm clinker rind locks the cup stamp, then walks the still-hot cup to the zenith staff and counts 18 swings of the 1.2 m plumb while a 6-leaf yarrow sprig, cut at 05:05 and pinned under the rim, shows a 3 mm wilt crease. A copied disc cannot grow that rind or crease a fresh sprig; a cold cup or uncreased leaf voids the bonus and forfeits the week's coal bond.
